notes.title: Reasons for sale
notes.notes: This is the first time we have released a game on steam, and it is also the first time since our team has been reorganized. We have to sell the key of this game because of cost and population control.We will have free games on weekends or in the near future. Inadequacies will be repaired and adjusted in the update, thank you for your support! Another console game, the sailing game of the nautical century, is also in the process of being produced. I hope to meet with you in the near future.
